description: A single-selection group of radios (DESIGN.md, RadioGroup): one tab stop with roving focus; arrows both move and select, as native radios do on the web. Each radio is a 20 circle with a 1.5 px TsuyaColors.borderStrong boundary; selected: accent fill with an 8 px TsuyaColors.onAccent dot.

constructors.description: A group of options, value selected, named label for screen readers.

params.name: value
params.description: The selected value, or null when nothing is selected yet.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with an option's value when it is selected.
